messages:
maria-finance: Heads-up — Vector Labs (acct VL-992) showing overdue INV-2026-017 for $24,900. Sent dunning 1 & 2, no response. Need plan: hold services or offer split pay? @lee-am @sam-cs

sam-cs: Chatted with their AM — theyre cashflow strapped after a delayed VC draw. Requested 3-part split, wants to keep Dedicated running.

lee-am: Client propose: $8.3k now, then $8.3k on 2026-04-01 and 2026-05-01. Asks to waive the $200 late fee if they meet schedule.

anjali-collections: We can do a payment plan but need a signed amendment + initial clearance. Recommend suspension after 7 days of a missed installment. Waiver needs exec ok. Also require ACH/wire for initial, card on file as fallback.

aj-legal: Ill draft the amendment template. Who will assemble the payment dates and wiring details?

maria-finance: I got it. Invoice: INV-2026-017, issued 2026-01-15, due 2026-02-12, $24,900. Proposed schedule in amendment: $8,300 today (or next business day), $8,300 2026-04-01, $8,300 2026-05-01. Remove $200 late fee conditional on no missed payments.

anjali-collections: Add clause: failure to pay within 7 days after due date = immediate suspension and collections escalation. Also require payment confirmation email to finance@redwood-inference.com.

lee-am: Client said they can wire the initial tomorrow morning. Will send POP and signed PO. Asking Legal to add signature block for AM + client CFO.

payment-bot: Alert: Next automated dunning email scheduled 2026-03-02 unless payment recorded.

sam-cs: If wire posts tomorrow, can we pre-authorize waiver so client can get a one-time clean record?

cfo: Provisional waiver OK after cleared funds. Finance to confirm clearing before removing fee.

maria-finance: I'll mark INV-2026-017 as "payment plan pending" and hold further escalation until 14 days after second installment due date. Draft amendment link: https://console.redwood.com/invoices/INV-2026-017/amendment (will attach tonight by 18:00 PST).

aj-legal: Draft ready, tagging for signatures. Please cc finance on the executed doc.

lee-am: Thanks. Ill confirm when wire clears and upload proof.

anjali-collections: Noted. If payment misses, start escalation path to collections@redwood-inference.com after suspension window.

maria-finance: Closing loop: if initial payment posts by EOD, we remove late fee hold and update ledger.

lee-am: Good. Will report back tomorrow. :thumbsup:
